text: 01AffordabilityHelping families get ahead instead of falling behind.Families are working hard, but affording basics like housing, groceries, childcare, healthcare, utilities, and property taxes keeps getting harder. I want to lower those everyday costs so families have the breathing room to get ahead, plan for the future, and be ready when life throws something unexpected their way. Because working more while earning less is not progress.Learn more →

02HealthcareNo Georgian should choose between insulin and rent.Getting sick shouldn't put your family's financial security at risk. I'll work to make healthcare more affordable and accessible, lower prescription drug and out-of-pocket costs, and expand Medicaid instead of continuing with Georgia's limited Pathways program. Families should be able to get the care they need without worrying about whether they can afford it.Learn more →

03EducationStrong schools. Supported teachers. Stronger communities.Strong public schools give children opportunities, support local families, and strengthen entire communities. I'll fight to fully fund Georgia's public schools, modernize our outdated funding formula, support teachers with competitive pay, and expand early learning opportunities. Every child deserves a strong start, and every family deserves to know their neighborhood school has the resources it needs to help their child succeed.Learn more →
